name: module-castellated-diagonal-black
title: Castellated radio module, ground array turned 45°, black soldermask
summary: Radio or processor module body: a black-soldermasked board on gold castellated pads (a plated half-hole notched into the board at each) in up to eight rows (two a side), a ground array turned 45°, up to 16 single pads, a nickel-silver shield can with rounded top edges and a stamped emboss groove round its label area (can_emboss_inset, can_emboss_width, can_emboss_depth) and a printed antenna meander at the +y end (antenna_trace, antenna_margin, antenna_turns), a notch cut from the can at its +x +y corner (can_notch_x, can_notch_y, can_notch_width, can_notch_length) and an antenna connector, a U.FL / MHF I receptacle (connector_x, connector_y: a white insulator base, a gold shell and centre contact); what a module lacks is parked at park_x and cut away.
provenance: Original work: the in-code module builder's construction (crates/solidcraft-integration/src/models/module.rs, retired with these files) made parametric in its rows, castellations, ground array, single pads and antenna meander, saved through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` at the module form's typical values (an original synthetic 18 × 25 mm castellated module) with its ground array turned 45°; the module generator gives every parameter its value. Outline, pad rows, pitch, can and ground array are the generator's (a module datasheet's mechanical drawing and land pattern, e.g. Espressif's public ESP32-S31-WROOM-3 datasheet v0.7 and ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 datasheet v1.8, https://www.espressif.com/sites/default/files/documentation/esp32-s3-wroom-1_wroom-1u_datasheet_en.pdf downloaded 18 November 2026, for their presets); pad and plating thickness, can edge round, the emboss groove, the antenna meander and the connector body (a U.FL / MHF I receptacle's typical 2.6 mm base, Ø2 mm shell, 1.25 mm height) are estimated. No vendor drawing, CAD model or EDA library data copied.
